The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d329f02eeb571170bba3b275df3c2fc3cb749b3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `592069136c016aec922b78fd9b977c80f870b062`

Inputs read: card #20963 body and its three comments (governing: triage's direction `5921865209`, the seat's claim `5922265892`, the newest `os-dev-report` `5922713698`); the seat's serial note `5922376322` on #20919 and, since it answers it, the cross-lane note `5922173894` on #6024 that names the move; ADR-0113 (D1, D2, D3, D5, Q1) at `origin/main`; PR #20956's record `5921191584`, ③ item 2; PR #21001 body, file list (3 files) and the net diff `7fa67dada3..592069136c` (+201/−7, one commit); the check-runs on the head, polled to convergence. Source premises (`error-response.ts` at the head and at `origin/main` `315888d660`, `import-runner.ts`, `import-row-schema-drift-20701.test.ts`, `rest.test.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `record-validator.ts`, `packages/rest/package.json`, the repo-wide `git grep` for the old hint text and for `notNull` reads) were read by `git show` / `git grep`; nothing was built, run, checked out or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) The not-null branch of `mapDataError` (`classifyDataError`, `error-response.ts:1813-1845` at the head).**
- Leads with the remedy, drift as a condition: the `hint` is two sentences. First: "The database column for 'FIELD' requires a value: provide it, or declare the field `required` in the object metadata." Second: "If the object declares neither `required` nor `storage: { notNull: true }` for 'FIELD', the physical schema has drifted from metadata instead: run 'os migrate' to reconcile (or reset the dev database)." Triage's direction (`5921865209`) and the card's shape are met literally.
- True in both cases. Declared `storage.notNull` without `required`: the first sentence is true (the column requires a value by declaration; D2 makes that the author's own DDL, D3 says a NOT NULL column over `storage.notNull: true` is no drift), and the second is a conditional whose condition is false, so it asserts nothing about this column. Genuinely drifted (column NOT NULL, metadata declares neither): the first sentence is true (the database refused; either remedy stops the refusal reaching the driver), and the second is true (D3/D5: a column stricter than its declaration is drift, `needs_confirm`, and `os migrate` is the door that reports and reconciles it; the remedy words are the old hint's own and the same sentence the unknown-column branch above it uses). The branch's reachable inputs partition into those two cases: the third cell, `required: true` over a NOT NULL column (D5's silent pre-17 case), cannot reach the branch, since `record-validator.ts:908` refuses a missing or null `required` value before any driver runs (D1). One residue outside the card's two cases, pre-existing and unchanged in kind: Q1's engine-populated `storage.notNull`-only column (an audit or tenant column such as `organization_id`, the very fixture `rest.test.ts:2505` uses) reaches this branch when the engine failed to populate it, and "provide it" is then not the caller's remedy; the old hint was no better there, and it is not a claim of this card. Not a verdict mover.
- No implied registry read or server check: the drift sentence is addressed to the reader as a condition to evaluate against the declaration ("If the object declares neither..."); the branch asserts nothing about what the object declares, which matches the branch's actual inputs (`error`, `object`). ⛔ No registry read was added (the diff touches no import and no lookup).
- Byte-unchanged envelope: the hunk removes five comment lines and the two old `hint` lines only; `status: 400`, `error`, `code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`, `fields: [{ field, code: 'required', message }]` and `...(object ? { object } : {})` are context lines, and no key is added. The three dialect regexes above the branch are untouched. Verified on the diff, and pinned by the exact key set (below).
- The branch comment is accurate against ADR-0113: "judges `required` only; nothing before the driver reads `storage.notNull`" holds at `origin/main` (the only non-test `notNull` reads outside `driver-sql` and `spec` are `cli/generate.ts` DDL emission, generated form labels, a `plugin-sharing` comment and rest's own two regex sites; `record-validator.ts` reads `required` and `requiredWhen`); "D1 / D2 keep the write contract and the column constraint apart on purpose" is D2 plus Q1's orthogonality argument; "lands here on a healthy schema, and `os migrate` changes nothing for it" is D3; "Drift (#2186) is the other way in: the column is NOT NULL and the metadata declares neither" is D3/D5. The retained `#2186` is in a code comment, not a runtime string, and was there before; the `hint` carries no tracker number.

**(b) The pin `packages/rest/src/data-not-null-hint-20963.test.ts` (three tests).**
- Real door, real driver: `RestServer.registerRoutes()` (`rest-server.ts:4357`) with the handlers taken from `getRoutes()` (`:13766`) and invoked for `POST /api/v1/data/:object` and `PATCH /api/v1/data/:object/:id`, over a real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, `syncSchemas`) + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`; the same harness as `import-row-schema-drift-20701.test.ts` (169 rest tests use `getRoutes()`), and every import is a declared `devDependency` of `@objectstack/rest`. No cross-package file read, no clocked window.
- The fixture test proves the ADR-0113 posture rather than assuming it: `must` carries `storage.notNull` and no `required`, and `engine.insert` without it rejects on `/not null/i`, so the refusal is the database's, after the validator.
- Asserts the correction by kind: the first sentence matches `requires a value`, `provide`, contains the literal backticked `required` and does not match `drift|os migrate`; exactly one sentence matches `drift|os migrate`, it begins with `If`, names `storage`, `notNull` and `os migrate`, and is not the first; the `PATCH` door's hint equals the `POST` door's byte for byte.
- Holds the control: status 400, `code`, `error`, the exact `required` finding, `object`, and the body's key set exactly `code, error, fields, hint, object` on both doors.
- Would red on the old hint, derived from the text rather than taken from the report: the old string splits on the pin's sentence rule into "If 'must' is optional ... has drifted from metadata." and "Run 'os migrate' ... database).", so `sentences[0]` fails `requires a value` and the drift-sentence count is 2, not 1; both hint tests red, the fixture test green, which is the 2-failed / 1-passed shape the dev's ablation reports (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` exists at `origin/main`). The pin's one fragility is cosmetic: its sentence splitter is a period followed by whitespace, so an abbreviation added to the hint later would need the pin adjusted; not a defect.

**(c) Confined to the claim's surface.** Three paths. `error-response.ts` moves only inside the not-null branch; the unknown-column branch, the unique-violation arm, the sandbox doors and the terminals are untouched. `import-runner.ts` is not in the diff, and the import row cannot inherit the change: `adoptDoorVerdict` copies only `code`, `field` and the sentence, and the `ROW_KEYS` pin (`import-row-schema-drift-20701.test.ts:186`) holds the row's key set without `hint`, so PR #20956's key set stands. Grep of `origin/main` for the old text ("optional in your object metadata", "is still NOT NULL", "has drifted from metadata. Run"): only `error-response.ts:1829-1831`, the lines this PR replaces. Every other consumer of the hint: `rest.test.ts:2518-2519` asserts `/os migrate/` and `/drifted from metadata/`, both of which the new second sentence still satisfies, so it stays green; `rest-unclassified-fault-status.test.ts:250` asserts status only. No page under `content/docs`, `docs/` or `skills/` quotes the hint (`cli.mdx:764` and `cli/migrate/plan.ts:67` use "drifted from metadata" for `os migrate plan`; `.changeset/20701-import-row-schema-drift-door-answer.md:13` quotes the unknown-column sentence). Nothing reds; one comment goes stale (③).

**(d) The changeset `20963-not-null-hint-declared-column.md` (`@objectstack/rest` `patch`) is accurate.** Its quoted "now reads" text is the code's string with 'FIELD' for the interpolation; "the first sentence holds for every NOT NULL refusal" holds for the two cases the card names (with the engine-populated residue in (a)); the two doors it names are the two the pin drives; "status, `code`, `error`, `fields` and `object` unchanged, no key added" is pinned exact; "the import row is untouched: it does not carry a `hint`" is the `ROW_KEYS` pin; "nothing reads the field map" is the diff. `Clause-②: no` is a bare line at the start of a line, the spelling `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` reads. The title carries the card number in the form every changeset here uses. It claims nothing undelivered. `Check Changeset` is `success`.

### ② Semver level

No `packages/spec/src/**` in the file list; no route, parameter, key or code is added or removed; the envelope's key set is unchanged (pinned exact); `hint` is guidance prose, never a declared vocabulary (ADR-0112's ledger governs `code`, which does not move); no request moves between accepted and refused.
